# Requirements analysis

Inspect the request and repository context. Record the user story, required fields, privacy and path-safety constraints, and acceptance criteria. Explicitly cover missing, empty, malformed, and secret values; null owner; empty endpoint collections; and unsafe paths. Do not design or implement. Deliver a concise requirements artifact for the architect.
